description: Selection on the rules house's bedroom, its level and its doors: the bedroom's only opening to the outside is its window, so "a door to the outside" fails while "any door" passes (O2 is to the living room); "only windows" over all its openings fails on O2; with no empty opening, a rule that needs any fails and one that needs all passes; both receptacles stand 240 mm above the floor, so "all at most 200 mm" fails; the level's one sleeping room is under 200 sq ft; its one alarm detects only smoke; and each of the three doors has no swing envelope.
